users_mobile_verified_requires_mobile.name: users_mobile_verified_requires_mobile
users_mobile_verified_requires_mobile.value: "users"."mobile_verified_at" is null or "users"."mobile" is not null

creator_profiles_paused_state.name: creator_profiles_paused_state
creator_profiles_paused_state.value:
("creator_profiles"."profile_status" = 'paused') = ("creator_profiles"."paused_at" is not null)
        and ("creator_profiles"."profile_status" <> 'paused' or "creator_profiles"."completed_at" is not null)

creator_profiles_completed_is_whole.name: creator_profiles_completed_is_whole
creator_profiles_completed_is_whole.value:
"creator_profiles"."profile_status" <> 'completed' or (
        "creator_profiles"."creator_category" is not null
        and "creator_profiles"."legal_form" is not null
        and "creator_profiles"."gst_status" is not null
        and "creator_profiles"."last_completed_step" = 'consent'
        and "creator_profiles"."completed_at" is not null
      )

consent_receipts_status_timestamps.name: consent_receipts_status_timestamps
consent_receipts_status_timestamps.value:
("consent_receipts"."status" = 'granted' and "consent_receipts"."granted_at" is not null and "consent_receipts"."withdrawn_at" is null)
        or ("consent_receipts"."status" = 'withdrawn' and "consent_receipts"."withdrawn_at" is not null)

data_erasure_requests_status_consistent.name: data_erasure_requests_status_consistent
data_erasure_requests_status_consistent.value:
("data_erasure_requests"."status" = 'completed' and "data_erasure_requests"."completed_at" is not null)
        or ("data_erasure_requests"."status" = 'deferred' and "data_erasure_requests"."completed_at" is null and cardinality("data_erasure_requests"."hold_reasons") > 0)

creator_professional_features_has_value.name: creator_professional_features_has_value
creator_professional_features_has_value.value: "creator_professional_features"."value_numeric" is not null or "creator_professional_features"."value_boolean" is not null or "creator_professional_features"."completeness" = 0

cashflow_account_months_non_negative.name: cashflow_account_months_non_negative
cashflow_account_months_non_negative.value:
"fin"."cashflow_account_months"."inflow_total" >= 0 and "fin"."cashflow_account_months"."outflow_total" >= 0 and "fin"."cashflow_account_months"."creator_income" between 0 and "fin"."cashflow_account_months"."inflow_total"
          and "fin"."cashflow_account_months"."own_transfers_in" >= 0 and "fin"."cashflow_account_months"."own_transfers_out" >= 0 and "fin"."cashflow_account_months"."transaction_count" >= 0

cashflow_accounts_retained_needs_life.name: cashflow_accounts_retained_needs_life
cashflow_accounts_retained_needs_life.value: not "fin"."cashflow_accounts"."transactions_retained" or ("fin"."cashflow_accounts"."data_life_until" is not null and "fin"."cashflow_accounts"."status" = 'delivered')

credit_applications_amounts_valid.name: credit_applications_amounts_valid
credit_applications_amounts_valid.value:
("fin"."credit_applications"."requested_amount" is null or "fin"."credit_applications"."requested_amount" between 10000 and 2500000)
          and ("fin"."credit_applications"."declared_monthly_income" is null or "fin"."credit_applications"."declared_monthly_income" between 0 and 10000000)
          and ("fin"."credit_applications"."declared_monthly_emi" is null or "fin"."credit_applications"."declared_monthly_emi" between 0 and 10000000)

credit_applications_purpose_note_valid.name: credit_applications_purpose_note_valid
credit_applications_purpose_note_valid.value:
"fin"."credit_applications"."purpose_note" is null or (char_length("fin"."credit_applications"."purpose_note") between 1 and 140
          and 'other' = any("fin"."credit_applications"."purposes"))

credit_applications_coverage_valid.name: credit_applications_coverage_valid
credit_applications_coverage_valid.value:
("fin"."credit_applications"."cashflow_coverage" is null or "fin"."credit_applications"."cashflow_coverage" in ('none', 'partial', 'complete'))
          and ("fin"."credit_applications"."missing_accounts_reason" is null or ("fin"."credit_applications"."missing_accounts_reason" in ('other_number_unavailable', 'bank_not_on_aa', 'chose_not_to_share')
            and "fin"."credit_applications"."accounts_complete_declared" = false))

credit_applications_ready_is_whole.name: credit_applications_ready_is_whole
credit_applications_ready_is_whole.value:
"fin"."credit_applications"."status" <> 'inputs_ready' or (
          "fin"."credit_applications"."details_completed_at" is not null and "fin"."credit_applications"."bureau_status" = 'completed'
          and "fin"."credit_applications"."cashflow_status" in ('completed', 'skipped') and "fin"."credit_applications"."inputs_ready_at" is not null)

credit_applications_closed_has_timestamp.name: credit_applications_closed_has_timestamp
credit_applications_closed_has_timestamp.value: "fin"."credit_applications"."status" not in ('withdrawn', 'expired') or "fin"."credit_applications"."closed_at" is not null

credit_applications_erased_is_empty.name: credit_applications_erased_is_empty
credit_applications_erased_is_empty.value:
"fin"."credit_applications"."inputs_erased_at" is null or (
          "fin"."credit_applications"."requested_amount" is null and "fin"."credit_applications"."declared_monthly_income" is null and "fin"."credit_applications"."declared_monthly_emi" is null
          and cardinality("fin"."credit_applications"."income_sources") = 0 and "fin"."credit_applications"."pan_masked" is null and "fin"."credit_applications"."purpose_note" is null
          and "fin"."credit_applications"."pan_fingerprint" is null)

credit_proposals_release_valid.name: credit_proposals_release_valid
credit_proposals_release_valid.value:
("fin"."credit_proposals"."released_at" is null) = ("fin"."credit_proposals"."released_by" is null) and ("fin"."credit_proposals"."released_at" is null) = ("fin"."credit_proposals"."release_reason" is null)
          and ("fin"."credit_proposals"."released_at" is null or "fin"."credit_proposals"."hold_reason" is not null)

credit_proposals_sent_has_reference.name: credit_proposals_sent_has_reference
credit_proposals_sent_has_reference.value: "fin"."credit_proposals"."status" not in ('submitted', 'decided') or ("fin"."credit_proposals"."lender_reference" is not null and "fin"."credit_proposals"."submitted_at" is not null)

decision_queries_resolved.name: decision_queries_resolved
decision_queries_resolved.value:
("fin"."decision_queries"."resolved_at" is null) = ("fin"."decision_queries"."resolved_decision_id" is null and "fin"."decision_queries"."withdrawn_by" is null)
          and ("fin"."decision_queries"."resolved_decision_id" is null or "fin"."decision_queries"."withdrawn_by" is null)
          and ("fin"."decision_queries"."withdrawn_by" is null) = ("fin"."decision_queries"."withdrawn_reason" is null)

decision_reviews_offer_shape.name: decision_reviews_offer_shape
decision_reviews_offer_shape.value:
("fin"."decision_reviews"."final_offer_terms" is null) = ("fin"."decision_reviews"."final_offer_expires_at" is null)
          and ("fin"."decision_reviews"."final_outcome" <> 'declined' or "fin"."decision_reviews"."final_offer_terms" is null)
          and ("fin"."decision_reviews"."final_offer_terms" is null or pg_column_size("fin"."decision_reviews"."final_offer_terms") <= 4096)

decision_reviews_override_has_reason.name: decision_reviews_override_has_reason
decision_reviews_override_has_reason.value: "fin"."decision_reviews"."action" <> 'override' or ("fin"."decision_reviews"."reason" is not null and char_length("fin"."decision_reviews"."reason") between 10 and 500)

decision_reviews_amounts_match_outcome.name: decision_reviews_amounts_match_outcome
decision_reviews_amounts_match_outcome.value:
("fin"."decision_reviews"."final_outcome" = 'declined') = ("fin"."decision_reviews"."final_exposure" is null)
          and ("fin"."decision_reviews"."final_exposure" is null or "fin"."decision_reviews"."final_exposure" between 10000 and 2500000)
          and ("fin"."decision_reviews"."final_tenor_months" is null or "fin"."decision_reviews"."final_tenor_months" between 3 and 60)

lender_decisions_offer_shape.name: lender_decisions_offer_shape
lender_decisions_offer_shape.value:
("fin"."lender_decisions"."offer_terms" is null) = ("fin"."lender_decisions"."offer_expires_at" is null)
          and ("fin"."lender_decisions"."outcome" <> 'declined' or "fin"."lender_decisions"."offer_terms" is null)
          and ("fin"."lender_decisions"."offer_terms" is null or pg_column_size("fin"."lender_decisions"."offer_terms") <= 4096)

lender_decisions_partner_fields.name: lender_decisions_partner_fields
lender_decisions_partner_fields.value: ("fin"."lender_decisions"."source" = 'partner_api') = ("fin"."lender_decisions"."idempotency_key" is not null and "fin"."lender_decisions"."request_hash" is not null and "fin"."lender_decisions"."api_key_prefix" is not null)

lender_decisions_amounts_match_outcome.name: lender_decisions_amounts_match_outcome
lender_decisions_amounts_match_outcome.value:
("fin"."lender_decisions"."outcome" = 'declined') = ("fin"."lender_decisions"."approved_exposure" is null)
          and ("fin"."lender_decisions"."approved_exposure" is null or "fin"."lender_decisions"."approved_exposure" > 0)

offer_responses_accept_shape.name: offer_responses_accept_shape
offer_responses_accept_shape.value:
("fin"."offer_responses"."response" = 'accepted') = ("fin"."offer_responses"."handoff_receipt_id" is not null and "fin"."offer_responses"."kfs_acknowledged")
          and ("fin"."offer_responses"."response" = 'declined' or "fin"."offer_responses"."decline_reason" is null)

integration_change_requests_approved_by_.name: integration_change_requests_approved_by_someone
integration_change_requests_approved_by_.value: "ops"."integration_change_requests"."status" <> 'applied' or not "ops"."integration_change_requests"."approval_required" or "ops"."integration_change_requests"."decided_by" is not null

provider_routes_paused_state.name: provider_routes_paused_state
provider_routes_paused_state.value: ("ops"."provider_routes"."paused" and "ops"."provider_routes"."paused_at" is not null and "ops"."provider_routes"."paused_reason" is not null) or (not "ops"."provider_routes"."paused" and "ops"."provider_routes"."paused_at" is null and "ops"."provider_routes"."paused_reason" is null)

simulated_lender_policies_four_eyes.name: simulated_lender_policies_four_eyes
simulated_lender_policies_four_eyes.value: "ops"."simulated_lender_policies"."decided_by" is null or "ops"."simulated_lender_policies"."proposed_by" is null or "ops"."simulated_lender_policies"."decided_by" <> "ops"."simulated_lender_policies"."proposed_by"

simulated_lender_policies_decided.name: simulated_lender_policies_decided
simulated_lender_policies_decided.value: "ops"."simulated_lender_policies"."status" = 'proposed' or "ops"."simulated_lender_policies"."proposed_by" is null or ("ops"."simulated_lender_policies"."decided_by" is not null and "ops"."simulated_lender_policies"."decided_at" is not null)

partner_api_keys_four_eyes.name: partner_api_keys_four_eyes
partner_api_keys_four_eyes.value: "ops"."partner_api_keys"."decided_by" is null or "ops"."partner_api_keys"."proposed_by" is null or "ops"."partner_api_keys"."decided_by" <> "ops"."partner_api_keys"."proposed_by"

partner_api_keys_approved.name: partner_api_keys_approved
partner_api_keys_approved.value: "ops"."partner_api_keys"."status" in ('pending', 'expired', 'cancelled') or "ops"."partner_api_keys"."proposed_by" is null or ("ops"."partner_api_keys"."decided_by" is not null and "ops"."partner_api_keys"."decided_at" is not null)

partner_api_keys_revoked.name: partner_api_keys_revoked
partner_api_keys_revoked.value: ("ops"."partner_api_keys"."status" = 'revoked') = ("ops"."partner_api_keys"."revoked_at" is not null and "ops"."partner_api_keys"."revoked_by" is not null)

partner_events_query_needed.name: partner_events_query_needed
partner_events_query_needed.value: "ops"."partner_events"."type" not in ('decision.queried', 'decision.query_withdrawn') or "ops"."partner_events"."query_id" is not null

partner_webhook_endpoints_four_eyes.name: partner_webhook_endpoints_four_eyes
partner_webhook_endpoints_four_eyes.value: "ops"."partner_webhook_endpoints"."decided_by" is null or "ops"."partner_webhook_endpoints"."proposed_by" is null or "ops"."partner_webhook_endpoints"."decided_by" <> "ops"."partner_webhook_endpoints"."proposed_by"

partner_webhook_endpoints_approved.name: partner_webhook_endpoints_approved
partner_webhook_endpoints_approved.value: "ops"."partner_webhook_endpoints"."status" in ('pending', 'expired', 'cancelled') or "ops"."partner_webhook_endpoints"."proposed_by" is null or ("ops"."partner_webhook_endpoints"."decided_by" is not null and "ops"."partner_webhook_endpoints"."decided_at" is not null)

access_requests_decision_shape.name: access_requests_decision_shape
access_requests_decision_shape.value:
("access_requests"."status" in ('approved', 'declined')) = ("access_requests"."decided_at" is not null)
        and ("access_requests"."status" = 'declined') = ("access_requests"."decline_reason" is not null)
        and ("access_requests"."status" = 'requested') = ("access_requests"."closed_at" is null)

creator_points_ledger_shape.name: creator_points_ledger_shape
creator_points_ledger_shape.value:
case "creator_points_ledger"."entry_type"
        when 'earn' then "creator_points_ledger"."amount" > 0 and "creator_points_ledger"."rule" is not null and "creator_points_ledger"."rules_version" is not null and "creator_points_ledger"."earn_key" is not null
        when 'hold' then "creator_points_ledger"."amount" < 0 and "creator_points_ledger"."rule" is null and "creator_points_ledger"."earn_key" is null
        when 'release' then "creator_points_ledger"."amount" > 0 and "creator_points_ledger"."rule" is null and "creator_points_ledger"."earn_key" is null
      end
